metadata.description: Official SpecsGraph plugins: agent skills for domain modelling over the SpecsGraph MCP server.

plugins.name: specsgraph
plugins.description: Domain modelling skills for SpecsGraph: director (routing), engineer (subdomains, contexts, model, behaviour, contracts, language, and roles), product (features and scenarios), brownfield (existing-codebase mapping), ingest (whole-project capture) and build (spec to merged code, with several agents). Requires the SpecsGraph MCP server.
